description: Sentry web API for managing organizations, teams and exporting error-monitoring data programmatically.
auth_notes: Sources show auth tokens for programmatic access, but do not state how they are sent on requests (header/Bearer) or whether OAuth2 is offered.
gate_detail: Sources do not say what plan or approval is needed to create an auth token. A token-creation tutorial and a Sandbox docs section exist, but no source states free-plan access.
api_scope: Web API for account-level resources such as organizations and teams, plus managing and exporting data; docs list resource groups like Projects, Releases, Events & Issues, Replays and SCIM.
mcp_notes: No source mentions an MCP server.
blocker_detail: Credential access prerequisites (plan, admin role, approval) are not stated in the provided sources.

evidence.quote: The Sentry web API is used to access the Sentry platform programmatically.
Auth tokens (short for *authentication tokens*) are a way to authenticate with Sentry.
They are similar to passwords but are designed for programmatic interaction with Sentry.
Tutorial: Create a Sentry Authentication Token
You can use the APIs to manage account-level resources, like organizations and teams, as well as manage and export data.

uncertainties: No source directly states whether a free plan or any specific role can create auth tokens, so access is unknown.
S4 (API auth page) is truncated, so how tokens are sent (e.g. Bearer header) is not shown.
S6 is Sentry Interactive (formerly Doordeck), a different product, and was ignored.
Pricing pages S2/S3 do not link plan tiers to API access.
REST style is inferred from 'web API' wording; webhooks, sandbox details and MCP are not covered.
